imagePos.description: Image placement relative to the title: "left" = image before title, "right" = image after title. Only "left" or "right" are valid. Irrelevant when title or image is empty (they are centered automatically).

contentType.description:
"html" allows inline tags only (
); color is the only CSS property allowed in style attributes.

persistent.description: Keep one countdown running across screens and reloads. Required true when expiry must redirect.

synchronizedCountdown.description: true: all timers share one clock; false: this timer counts independently.

text.description: May contain {{countdown}} for the remaining time.

buttonText.description: May contain {{countdown}} for the remaining time.

completeAction.description: Runs when the countdown reaches zero — e.g. navigate to a full-price twin screen.

oldPrice.description: Struck-through pre-discount price. Present only on discounted offers.

price.description: The price charged today, shown prominently.

oldPrice.description: Struck-through pre-discount price. Present only on discounted offers.

label.description: Secondary price line — usually the renewal/full price or a per-period note.

__schema22.description: Gap below the element. On a fixed element this is the gap to the NEXT fixed element, not a distance from the screen edge. Omit to inherit the theme default.

__schema36.description: "fixed" pins the element into the bottom attached stack (fixed elements stack in document order); "static"/absent = normal flow.

inputId.description: Id of the source Options/Plans/Input element whose answer picks the branch.

values.description: Array of [key, target] pairs. Under strict matching (the default), keys are option/plan ids — never option values or labels. Target: a screen id, or null for the next screen in tree order; unmatched answers also go to the next screen in tree order.

strict.description: Default true: keys match option/plan ids. false: keys match typed/option values.
